result.instructions: Tools for DoubleTick, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customers wrote to our WhatsApp number today and are still unassigned?"; "Show the delivery status of the message with ID 3f2a9c1e-5b7d-4e8a-9c21-7d4e5f6a8b90."; "Send the approved order_shipped template to +919999999999 with the order number.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes DoubleTick data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run doubletick_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run doubletick_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run doubletick_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. doubletick_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: doubletick_list_channels
tools.title: List WhatsApp channels
tools.description: List the WhatsApp numbers (channels) connected to the account, with each business profile. Optionally filter by one WhatsApp number. Read-only. Calls GET /organization/channel/profile.

wabaNumber.description: Only this connected WhatsApp number, with country code.

tools.name: doubletick_list_chats
tools.title: List chats (inbox)
tools.description: List the chats in the team inbox, with optional filters and cursor paging (send nextChatId and nextChatTimestamp from the previous page). Read-only. Calls GET /chats.

status.description: Chat status filter, as the DoubleTick inbox uses it.

assignedUserPhone.description: Phone of the assigned team member. Send the text "null" for unassigned chats.

nextChatId.description: Paging: nextChatId from the previous response.

nextChatTimestamp.description: Paging: nextChatTimestamp from the previous response.

tools.name: doubletick_get_chat_messages
tools.title: Get chat messages
tools.description: Return the messages between one connected WhatsApp number and one customer, optionally for a date range. Read-only. Calls GET /chat-messages.

wabaNumber.description: Connected WhatsApp number, with country code.

customerNumber.description: Customer phone number, with country code.

startDate.description: Start of the range, date as DD-MM-YYYY, e.g. 17-11-2026.

endDate.description: End of the range, date as DD-MM-YYYY, e.g. 17-11-2026.

tools.name: doubletick_get_message_status
tools.title: Get message status
tools.description: Return the delivery timeline (sent, delivered, read, replied, failed) of a message sent through DoubleTick. Read-only. Calls GET /whatsapp/message/status.

messageId.description: Message ID (UUID) returned by a send tool.

tools.name: doubletick_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer details
tools.description: Return one customer's name, phone number, assigned team member, tags and custom fields. Give a phone number or a customer ID. Read-only. Calls GET /customer/details.

phoneNumber.description: Customer phone number with country code, e.g. +919999999999.

customerId.description: Customer ID, for a customer without a phone number.

wabaNumber.description: Connected WhatsApp number that holds the chat.

tools.name: doubletick_get_chat_window_status
tools.title: Get 24-hour window status
tools.description: Check whether the 24-hour customer service window is open for a customer on a WhatsApp number. Open means free-form text is allowed. Read-only. Calls GET /chat/status.

customerPhoneNumber.description: Customer phone number with country code, e.g. +919999999999.

wabaNumber.description: Connected WhatsApp number. Left out, DoubleTick uses one of the account's numbers.

tools.name: doubletick_list_templates
tools.title: List WhatsApp templates
tools.description: List the WhatsApp message templates with their components, approval status and WhatsApp number. Read-only. Calls GET /v2/templates.

category.description: Category filter, e.g. MARKETING or UTILITY.

tools.name: doubletick_get_wallet_balance
tools.title: Get wallet balance
tools.description: Return the DoubleTick wallet balance and currency of the organization. Read-only. Calls GET /wallet/balance.

tools.name: doubletick_list_team
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List every team member of the organization with their reporting manager. Read-only. Calls GET /team.

tools.name: doubletick_send_text
tools.title: Send WhatsApp text
tools.description: Send one plain text WhatsApp message to a customer or a WhatsApp group. It reaches a real person and cannot be recalled. Works only inside the customer's 24-hour window (see doubletick_get_chat_window_status). Confirm the recipient and the text with the user before calling. Calls POST /whatsapp/message/text.

to.description: Recipient phone number with country code, e.g. +919999999999. Give this or groupId.

groupId.description: WhatsApp group ID. Give this or to.

from.description: Connected WhatsApp number to send from. Left out, DoubleTick uses one of the account's numbers.

text.description: Message text, up to 4096 characters. Blank text is refused.

tools.name: doubletick_send_template
tools.title: Send WhatsApp template
tools.description: Send one approved WhatsApp template message to a customer or a WhatsApp group. Works outside the 24-hour window. It reaches a real person and cannot be recalled. Confirm the recipient and the content with the user before calling. Calls POST /v2/whatsapp/message/template.

to.description: Recipient phone number with country code, e.g. +919999999999. Give this or groupId.

groupId.description: WhatsApp group ID. Give this or to.

from.description: Connected WhatsApp number to send from.

templateName.description: Approved template name, as listed by doubletick_list_templates.

bodyPlaceholders.description: Body variables as key-value objects in order, e.g. [{"name":"John"},{"url":"https://example.com"}].

tools.name: doubletick_assign_customer_tags
tools.title: Assign tags and custom fields
tools.description: Add tags, set custom field values and set the name of one customer. Existing tags and fields not listed stay as they are. Calling it again with the same values changes nothing. Calls POST /customer/assign-tags-custom-fields.

phone.description: Customer phone number with country code, e.g. +919999999999.

wabaNumber.description: Connected WhatsApp number that holds the chat. Needed for chat-level tags.

tags.description: Tags to add, each up to 50 characters.

customFields.description: Custom fields to set, as name and value pairs.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with DoubleTick
prompts.description: What you can do with DoubleTick here, with example requests to try.
